data.title: Market data
data.none: No market data yet. Refresh first.
data.holdoutHint: Locked from this day, hidden from gates and models
data.costHint: Long-short leg, tiered by the symbol's monthly volume rank: 1-20 / 21-50 / rest
data.refreshHint: Lists symbols, pulls daily bars to rank the pool, then pulls 15m, funding, premium and metrics per symbol and assembles panels, and finally builds the reference grid. The first run is long; a rerun only fills what is missing. It also runs by itself from 14:00 UTC on the 1st of each month to rank that month's pool; a failed run is retried an hour later, and while another job is running it waits for it to finish.
data.thin: Thin coverage (kept in the pool, gaps are empty)
data.productHint: These symbols are loaded into memory for the time-series report only; it is shown to the reviewer and here, never gated.

pool.title: Universe
pool.hint: At each month start, the top N by 30-day average daily quote volume, using only data before that month. Delisted symbols included.
pool.statusHint: Per-symbol stats written at refresh. Click a header to sort.
pool.loadedHint: (6h grid moment, in-pool symbol) pairs used by the cross-sectional evaluation
pool.gridNotReady: not built yet, G6 fails until it is

campaign.title: Start a campaign
campaign.hint: After each round the model writes lessons and the next round starts on its own, until the round count, the survivor cap or the time limit is reached. One campaign at a time.
campaign.notePh: e.g. funding carry and liquidation imbalance only

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.hint: Written after each round of the expanded campaign, newest first; proposals carry the latest 20 across all campaigns.

detail.pick: Pick a round on the left, or start a campaign.

cand.title: Candidates
cand.empty: No candidates in this round yet.
cand.directionAsked: an older candidate that never declared one; the generator was asked during re-evaluation, given only the hypothesis and the expression

observe.title: Observation
observe.hint: Candidates that cleared every gate, the review and the batch BH wait here with their holdout already computed. They are already in the redundancy set while here; approved ones also join the combination. Approval has conditions: re-evaluated on the current data with every gate passed, and on the span it has never seen (since its round's cut) the primary-horizon IC has the search-span sign, at least 150 points and a point-level t ≥ 2; every data refresh re-evaluates automatically, so a candidate below the bar just waits for more data.
observe.reevalHint: Every candidate here is recomputed under today's gates (funding, known-effect references, direction) and screened against the others as one batch. Results are stored under each card; the original numbers and status stay as they were, and no trials are counted. About a minute each.
observe.peers: Cross-sectional |ρ| with the other candidates here

brief.neutralValue: after regressing out {{n}} known effects: primary IC {{ic}}, {{kept}} of the original, t {{t}} (a label, not a gate)
brief.gainSharpeRecent: G9 net Sharpe (since {{from}}, judged; before → after)
brief.gainSharpeFull: Full-period net Sharpe (shown, not judged; before → after)
brief.unseen: Never seen by it (from its discovery round's cut {{from}})

board.title: Factor board
board.hint: How the library's active factors see the product coins at the {{day}} 00:00 UTC close — computed at the same moment and on the same data as the trader's rebalance, refreshed daily after 00:15.
board.none: Nothing yet. The board appears after the trader's daily 00:15 UTC rebalance.
board.legend: Each factor ranks the whole pool from strongest to weakest in the direction it learned from history: the top fifth is bullish, the bottom fifth bearish, the rest neutral — the same rule the trader uses to pick coins. It is about relative strength, not absolute moves: bullish means stronger than most of the pool over the next 24 hours. A factor marked “not in the combo” loses money on its own after costs, so the trader does not use it and it only shows its view here; “not computable today” means a column it needs could not be filled in today.

library.title: Factor library
library.comboHint: Each library factor is ranked across symbols at each moment, z-scored and summed with a weight whose sign follows its training-window monthly cross-sectional IC and whose size is the net return of trading it alone as a long-short leg after costs and funding; a factor that does not make money gets zero. Same walk-forward as single factors; holdout weights are fit on the whole search span.
library.comboNone: No data loaded, so the combination report can't be computed.
library.comboComputing: The library just changed; the combination report is being recomputed in the background, a minute or two.
library.weights: Primary-horizon weights: the factor's own leg net return per period (bps) and its share of the absolute sum
library.latest: Cross-sectional signal at the last grid moment ({{time}} UTC)
library.retiredHint: Out of the combo and the trader, no longer a G6 comparison or the G9 baseline; open one for details or to restore it.
library.retireHint: Remove it from the library: it leaves the combo and the trader, no longer counts as a G6 comparison, a G8 known structure or the G9 baseline, and is no longer listed as in the library when proposing; the reason goes into the tried list. Nothing is deleted, it stays in the retired list below and can be restored.
library.retirePh: Why it retires, e.g. its own leg loses money after costs and drags the combo
library.restoreHint: Back in the library; the trader's tick is not restored automatically.
library.reevalHint: Every library factor is recomputed under today's gates: the G9 baseline is the library without it plus basis carry, G6 compares against the references, the other library factors and the observation list, G10 uses the direction it declared. Results are stored separately in the detail view; the approval numbers and status stay as they were. About a minute each.
library.recheckHint: IC on data after approval only.

reference.title: Reference set
reference.hint: 5 hand-written baselines plus the Alpha158 rewrite. A ruler, never approved; no redundancy check, no BH.
reference.windowsHint: None selected means every window; baselines and candle-shape factors always run.

models.title: Models
models.needBoth: Configure both the proposer and the reviewer first; the same model tends to agree with itself, so different ones are better.

eval.title: Evaluate an expression
eval.hint: Runs every gate on the search span in the background; a holdout is computed only when every gate passes, as in a campaign. Not part of a round and not counted as a trial. Ctrl+Enter to submit.
eval.queued: Queued behind the two candidates a campaign is evaluating: {{expr}}

trader.title: Trader account
trader.hint: Paper account quant-factor: every day it signals on the 15m bar closing at 00:00 UTC and rebalances the whole basket at 00:15 — capital split between the combo of the selected factors and basis carry (skipping coins listed under a year) by the carry share set below, both sides sized by inverse volatility with no coin above twice the side's average, 4x cross market orders, no stops. The paper venue is optimistic: 0.04% fees and no slippage; the backtest fills one bar later at 5 / 8 / 12 bps per side.
trader.noAccount: No rebalance yet: the account is created on the first one.
trader.schedule: Fetches data from 00:05 UTC and trades at 00:15; retried until 01:00, after that the day is skipped
trader.todayHint: {{pct}}, since the equity before the {{day}} rebalance
trader.stale: Can't reach the paper venue — numbers frozen at {{time}}
trader.down: Can't reach the paper venue — no account numbers yet
trader.dailyHint: A day runs from the equity before that day's rebalance to the equity before the next one (00:15 → 00:15 UTC), including the rebalance fees and the funding in between; the last day hasn't reached the next rebalance yet and follows the live numbers. The two legs and "backtest due" use that day's target weights, the 00:15 closes, the funding actually settled and the backtest costs (5 / 8 / 12 bps a side), and appear after the next rebalance; gap = actual − due, the execution slippage. Each leg's drawdown is on its own share of capital; when the drawdown touches the stop line (combo 22.8%, carry 37%, measured on the search span, fixed) you switch that leg off and its share sits idle.
trader.legHit: Hit the stop line; switch this leg off
trader.carryExpr: basis_7d = Mean($premium, 672), direction fixed at −1 (short the rich premium), skipping coins listed under a year. Its share of capital is set below, the combo leg takes the rest; switched off, that share sits idle and is not given to the combo leg.
trader.carryOff: Off: the carry leg holds nothing from the next rebalance on
trader.carryShareHint: also the share used by backtests and the G9 baseline: re-evaluate the library and the observation list after changing it and recalibrate the G9 line; locked while a campaign or a re-evaluation runs
trader.positionsHint: Leg split: target notional each leg gave this coin in the {{day}} rebalance (signed).
trader.runsHint: Click a row for that day: targets vs fills, and why anything failed.
trader.noFactors: No factor selected; the combo leg stays flat
trader.factorsHint: Only selected factors feed the combo leg, from the next rebalance on; being in the library does not mean being traded. Compare runs the trading scheme on the search span for the current selection and for it with this factor added or removed; holdout is shown only when the search span improves, so nobody picks by holdout. Selecting is your call.
trader.missing: The live tail cannot provide {{cols}}; cannot be selected

compareStage.inputs: preparing the skeleton and carry inputs

trader.betterNo: Search span did not improve; no holdout.
